articles.title: Lee's approval rating dips after 2-week rise: poll
articles.description: President Lee Jae Myung's approval rating fell slightly last week following a two-week rise, a poll showed Monday. In the poll conducted on 2,515 adults nationwide from last Monday through Friday, positive assessments of Lee's job performance stood at 37.4 percent, down 0.5 percentage point from the previous week, Realmeter said.
